title: Stamped Commit counts only if published and valid (decided)
description: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-17), option A (fixes CRY2-2 / IMP2-1 stall): members process stamped Commits in stamp order and take the first that (1) is published within a fixed window (e.g. 10 s after its stamp) and (2) validates (well-formed MLS Commit by a member authorized for that change under Space state); unpublished or invalid stamped Commits are skipped identically by all members.
